title: Lawrence E. Corbridge
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Bachelor of Business Managent and Finance, BYU 1973; Juris Doctorate, BYU 1976
Married Jacquelyn Gayle Shamo 1974, Provo Utah Temple; five sons
Partner and senior attorney of law firm, Corbridge Baird & Christensen
President of the Chile Santiago North Mission, 2002-2005
